Deconvoluted mass spectrum shown as a line/intensity trace (a line plot), which is exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.

Bars show the proportion of a protein population bound to 0/1/2/3 metal atoms, derived directly from relative peak intensities of a single native MS spectrum (as in panels A/B), not a mean calculated across independent replicate samples. There is no underlying set of replicate values to overlay.

Bars represent per-residue chemical shift perturbations measured from single NMR spectra at each of three metal equivalents (a titration readout), not a mean computed across biological/technical replicates, so there are no individual replicate values to overlay.
